contract: distribution_id is an operator-configured stored version UUID. Provider ID must match that version's catalog product. region/time_window are recorded request context but this initial workflow checks metadata access only. Evidence explicitly states region_and_time_verified=false and scientific_status=not_validated.
authorization: New source_operator membership role grants source:manage, intersected with token scopes. No automatic source-management grant to researchers or administrators. Both submission and status reads require active organization membership and source:manage.
durability: Tenant RLS, composite distribution ownership, request-hash idempotency, committed claims, 60-second lease recovery, fencing tokens and terminal publication. Transient infrastructure errors leave recoverable claims; expected provider/metadata errors publish sanitized SOURCE_PROBE_REJECTED. A successful access probe may report metadata_matches_pinned_version=false; this is source drift evidence, not scientific success.
limits: Approved configured hosts/datasets only, no caller URL. Metadata HTTP is limited to at most 1 MiB and 20 seconds, rejects redirects/private DNS/compressed responses through existing ERDDAP transport. Operator scheduling and infrastructure rate quotas remain deployment responsibilities.
runtime: ORCA_SOURCE_PROBES_ENABLED defaults false. Requires runtime database URL and ORCA_ACQUISITION_SOURCES bindings, without enabling snapshot acquisition or requiring S3. Run python -m orca.probe_worker --tenant UUID --watch. Configuration acknowledgement is not a worker heartbeat.
deployment: Only isolated local migration/test execution; production Supabase unchanged.
remaining: Subset, QC, rights and compatible baseline scientific probes
